title: Web Hosting Plans Late Renewal Fee Schedule
content:
## Late renewal fee — Web Hosting Plans

**Rule.** The overdue renewal amount carries a late renewal fee that depends on the whole calendar days from the term end date to today and on the plan's declined auto-renew attempts:

1. more than 2 days late after a fully declined cycle — the plan carries at least 3 declined auto-renew attempts dated less than one calendar month before today — carries USD 3.50 for each whole day past the term end date;
2. more than 2 days late without a fully declined cycle carries 5 percent of the regular price, rounded half up to the cent;
3. 2 days late or fewer carries no late renewal fee.

The regular price here is the plan tier's regular price for the new term length (the regular rate for that length multiplied by its months, or the 1-month price), before any discount.

| Days from the term end date to today | At least 3 declined auto-renew attempts dated less than one calendar month before today | Late renewal fee |
|---|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | either | none |
| 3 or more | yes | USD 3.50 for each whole day past the term end date |
| 3 or more | no | 5 percent of the regular price, rounded half up |

**Worked cases (hypothetical dates and prices; term end date 4 March).**

- Today 6 March: 2 days — no fee.
- Today 13 March, three declined attempts dated in late February: 9 days — fee USD 31.50.
- Today 13 March, only two declined attempts in that month: 9 days — fee 5 percent of a hypothetical regular price of USD 251.70, which is 12.585, rounded half up to USD 12.59.
